title: Research dispatcher: starvation-floor one-fire cap and infra yield defer the exempt trainer/kaggle_cpu backends (trainer idle since 03:25Z 2026-11-19)
note: MEASURED dispatcher run 44492257802 (09:19Z): backpressure repo queued 68 fresh (cap 10), 121 stale >24h ignored (gh list truncated at 200; repo-wide queued ~456), infra queued 2 (yield at 2). The infra block was lifted by the starvation floor, which caps the cycle at inflight+1 = 4: one runner unit fired, and every other unit incl. trainer a10d-03 was deferred on 'research compute cap 4 reached' while trainer showed 0/1 busy. Trainer and kaggle_cpu are already in limits.repo_queued_exempt_backends, but the floor clears the block, so soft_block goes False and the inflight+1 cap binds them. Infra yield never honoured the exemption. Fix: exempt backends are bounded by their own max_concurrent and max_total_inflight, never by the floor's one-fire cap or the infra yield. Manager-proposed (excluding runs >6h) does not address this: the block that cycle was infra-kind.
